messages:
anya: quick ask — can someone run a short continuous-batching throughput run against the prod-13b variant? need numbers for max_tokens=[32,64,128,256] x batch_size=[8,16,32]. target steady-state per-config: ~2 minutes. doing this to validate the cb fallback math + new queueing tune for next rollout. cc @mike @ravi :rocket:

mike: I can take the runs on a100-pool later today. what client concurrency should we use? also confirm we want `prefill=false` and warmup=30s, right? :eyes:

ravi: yep, warmup=30s sounds right. use client-concurrency=16 for the a100 job. watch for the small-batch fallback threshold — the runtime currently flips to serial small-batch if max_tokens < 48 on that model (we changed it in the last PR). if you want to exercise the fallback explicitly, include a run with max_tokens=40. also pin model to `prod-13b:v2026-02-18` so we compare apples to apples.

mike: posting the loadgen command I'll run (copy in case you want to tweak):
```
loadgen run \ 
  --target-qps 80 \ 
  --duration 150 \ 
  --client-concurrency 16 \ 
  --model prod-13b:v2026-02-18 \ 
  --max-tokens {32,40,64,128,256} \ 
  --batch-sizes {8,16,32} \ 
  --prefill false \ 
  --warmup 30 \ 
  --output /tmp/cb-run-2112345678.csv
```
I will run 3 repeats per config and tar the CSVs. planning to kick off at ~16:00 PT.

anya: perfect. please drop the tar into drive: https://go.redwood/internal/perf/cb-runs/2112345678 and paste the link here when done. include a one-line note if you see any tail latency spikes or OOMs. :thumbsup:

bench-bot: scheduled job job-2112345678-a100-1 by mike. queued on pool a100-pool-2. will post run summary when finished.

mike: run started 16:03 PT. initial note: we saw a short KV-cache miss storm during the first 20s for the max_tokens=256 configs (LRU thrash). watching.

ravi: thanks — if the cache miss correlates with sequence length distribution we may need a quick kernel-level metric: membandwidth and L2 evict rate. ping eng-infra for access if you need counters.

sara: small request — can one of you add a perf check to the CB PR (4382) that validates no >10% regression in median tokens/s across these configs? just a single assertion in the post-merge job is fine. we need the guard for the rollout.

mike: will attach results and a short notes.txt. early numbers look like: median tokens/s drop ~6% at max_tokens=256 vs baseline, 12% at the 40-token explicit-fallback case (so fallback path is a clear perf regression). attaching CSV now: https://go.redwood/internal/perf/cb-runs/2112345678/cb-results.tar.gz

anya: got it, thanks. ravi — can you follow up on fallback path optimization (maybe reduce mem churn or adjust small-batch concurrency)? i'll open a follow-up ticket and assign to you. :spiral_calendar:

ravi: will do. initial idea: raise small-batch parallelism by 2x and add a fast-path that skips LRU touches for the short sequences. I'll prototype on the bench branch.

bench-bot: job job-2112345678-a100-1 completed. summary: 45 configs run, avg duration 150s. no OOMs. notable: 40-token explicit-fallback shows 11% lower median throughput and 95th p99 latency increased for that path. full CSVs uploaded to provided drive link.

anya: awesome — scheduling a brief async writeup in the eng-runtime thread later today. thanks everyone. (reacted :thumbsup:)
